node.title: Re: Selecting Password
node.author: hippo
node.doctext: While you could jump through hoops to escape certain characters in your password from within Perl and the shell and [man://echo], I would probably look for a ready-made solution instead such as [metamod://Authen::PAM]. See eg. [https://metacpan.org/pod/distribution/Authen-PAM/PAM/FAQ.pod#2.-Can-I-change-a-password-non-interactively?|Can I change a password non-interactively?] from the FAQ there.
